## Full Job Description
Lead the fabrication backbone of Firefly's Ground Support Equipment Team as the Senior Manager of GSE Fabrication. This role involves oversight and leadership over the activities in the GSE weldshop, GSE field technicians, OTW welding, GSE fluids panel shop, the traveling GSE technician team, and I&C technician teams. You will work hand in hand with the GSE process manager to support the various work centers/factories under your umbrella.
As Senior Manager of GSE Fabrication, you'll lead a multidisciplinary fabrication team responsible for the fabrication, assembly, and installation of ground support equipment across all of Firefly's programs. Your team will primarily work out of Briggs but will support remote build sites and travel to complete critical projects across all Firefly locations.

...

Fabrication Management:
* Oversee all fabrication activities including welding, panel fabrication, and I&C integration
* Ensure fabrication processes meet quality standards, safety regulations, and project specifications
* Coordinate with the GSE process manager to align fabrication activities with overall GSE objectives
* Manage fabrication schedules and resource plans for fabrication efforts
* Track fabrication progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies including overtime, weekend support, improved tooling, or organizational solutions.
* Manage scope changes and ensure proper change control processes
* Manage Fabrication sprint using Agile principles and best practices

...

* Partner with Engineering, Leadership, and applicable Operations teams to schedule and execute fabrication/installation efforts without interfering with ongoing operations or other design plans
* Provide and maintain a cohesive resource plan for GSE Leadership
* Support Facilities team on shop infrastructure and equipment needs
* Engage with customers and stakeholders on technical requirements and fabrication reviews

...

Required Qualifications
* Minimum 10+ years of fabrication management experience in aerospace, defense, oil and gas, or similar industries
* Minimum 5+ years of fabrication leadership or people management experience
* Strong background in welding, fluid system fabrication, and I&C integration
* Experience with fabrication processes including welding, machining, and assembly
* Experience with quality management systems including AS9100
* Deep knowledge of fabrication standards and codes including AWS, ASME, ISO
* Familiarity with AS9100 Quality management systems
* Experience managing fabrication teams and delivering complex technical projects
* Proven ability to manage schedules and resources across multiple projects
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make sound fabrication judgments under pressure
* Excellent communication skills and conflict resolution skills for diverse audiences
* Ability to work in fast-paced environment with evolving requirements and tight deadlines
* Flexibility to support critical operations including extended hours and occasional travel
* U. S. Person status required (U. S. Citizen, Lawful Permanent Resident, Refugee, or Asylee) due to ITAR/EAR requirements

...

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, a related field, or applicable Technical management expertise

* Direct experience with rocket engine test stands, launch pads, or propulsion test facilities fabrication

...

* Familiarity with MIL-STD specifications and military/government engineering requirements
* Experience with AS9100 aerospace quality management systems
* Proficiency with fabrication planning and scheduling software and tools, like JIRA
* Knowledge of oxygen cleaning requirements per ASTM G93 and CGA standards
* Experience with hazardous location design and NFPA 70 electrical area classification fabrication
* Six Sigma or Lean certification.
* Experience with Odoo ERP or similar enterprise systems.
* Previous experience managing fabrication teams in startup or high-growth environments.
Firefly offers outstanding benefits for our employees, including generous health, dental and vision plans with low plan deductibles, parental leave, educational & relocation reimbursement, short term disability, and flexible PTO options.

## About Firefly Space Systems
Firefly Space Systems was an American aerospace manufacturer based in Cedar Park, Texas. The company was founded in 2013 with the goal of developing low-cost launch vehicles for the small satellite industry. Firefly's Alpha rocket was designed to carry payloads of up to 1,000 kg to low Earth orbit. The company was acquired by EOS Launcher in 2017 and is now known as Firefly Aerospace.
Firefly Aerospace is continuing the development of the Alpha rocket and is also working on a larger rocket called Beta, which is designed to carry payloads of up to 8,000 kg to low Earth orbit. Firefly Aerospace is committed to providing affordable access to space for small satellite operators.

# Technical Program Manager, Hardware Development
| Job Category | Supply Chain |

**What to Expect**
Tesla's Hardware Development team is responsible for managing supplier-driven changes, deviations, and sustainability initiatives across our supply base. The Technical Program Manager will work closely with many organizations, both internal and external to Tesla.
In this role, you will drive Process Change Requests (PCRs), supplier deviations, semiconductor part performance, and spend mapping from initial request through approval, implementation, and closure. You will act as the central point of contact between Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Project management teams globally, as well as Tesla's Executive Team.
The work environment is demanding, fast-paced, and incredibly exciting. The ideal candidate should be ready to push their limits, as they join a highly motivated and capable team to make unbelievable things into reality.
**What You’ll Do**
* Develop a deep understanding of Tesla's PCR and deviation processes to ensure changes are properly reviewed, validated, and approved before implementation
* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of PCRs and deviations with cross-functional stakeholders, identifying the critical path and driving timely approvals, implementation, and closure
* Monitor defect pareto by different part families, system designs, semiconductor manufacturers and owners and drive global actions to make permanent changes in designs, reliability plans and manufacturing processes
* Create and manage dashboards for Purchasing status, spends, risk analysis and lead appropriate actions with rightful owners
* Lead carbon reduction programs and black projects with suppliers and internal teams, including tracking emissions data, setting targets, and delivering reduction milestones and report to Tesla's executive leadership
* Identify opportunities to apply proven solutions across different semiconductor part manufacturing processes
* Communicate concisely and clearly to internal teams on risks, path to mitigation, and status of actions
* Translate technical problems and data into actionable plans with clear milestones and owners
* Assess, analyze, consolidate, and communicate risk and status, calling out key issues and presenting the path to resolution in cross-functional forums, from working-level teams to senior executives
**What You’ll Bring**
* Degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science, or a similar technical discipline, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of program management experience, preferably in supply chain, supplier quality, manufacturing, or sustainability programs. Prior technical expertise (process engineering, quality engineering, or design engineering) is preferred
* Experience with change management processes (such as PCRs, ECOs, or deviations) and quality systems is preferred
* Experience preparing executive-level presentations focused on impact, actions, and milestones
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, especially senior management
* Ability to work independently on multiple tasks and projects with various stakeholders
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
* Demonstrated ability to identify business process issues and drive process improvement
**Compensation and Benefits**
Benefits

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
